newsitem.title: MOROCCO: French foreign minister to visit Morocco next week.
newsitem.headline: French foreign minister to visit Morocco next week.

text.p: France's newly-appointed Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine will pay a two-day visit to Morocco on July 28-29, the French embassy said on Friday.
Diplomatic sources said he was expected to prepare for a visit by Prime Minister Lionel Jospin later this year.
The embassy said the visit by Vedrine, the first by a French minister since the socialist government took power last month, was to boost bilateral relations.
